# How to Evaluate an AI Whiteboard Video Generator


Test an AI whiteboard generator with one fixed brief. Record source fidelity, first output, editing work, actual production time and paid export requirements.


Mira Chen


•


June 30, 2026 •


4 min read


Use one approved script, one visual brief, and one scoring sheet to evaluate an AI whiteboard video generator. Below is a copyable test and an existing Golpo PDF example. The steps are a method you can run; they are not results from seven paid accounts. For the product shortlist and prices, start with the[whiteboard animation software comparison](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/best-whiteboard-animation-software) .


## Copy this evaluation brief


Use the same input in each finalist. If a product needs a different input format, record that change before judging its output.


**Script:** the exact spoken words.


> A support request moves through three stages: received, assigned, and resolved. Received means the request has entered the queue. Assigned means a named owner is investigating it. Resolved means the owner has recorded the solution and notified the requester. If the issue returns, reopen the same request so its history stays together.


**Video Instructions:** Draw a three-stage support flow labeled RECEIVED, ASSIGNED, and RESOLVED. Highlight the owner at ASSIGNED. Draw a return arrow from RESOLVED to ASSIGNED labeled REOPEN. Keep every label readable. Use one consistent drawing style.


**Voice Instructions:** Calm, clear explanation for a new support teammate. Emphasize the difference between assigned and resolved.


In Golpo, these fields have different jobs: Script is spoken, Video Instructions describe pictures, and Voice Instructions direct delivery. On another product, record which settings can represent the same brief. Do not claim a feature failed when the tool was configured for a different task.


## Save the first result before repairing it


- Product, plan, test date, language, duration, aspect ratio, style, and all instructions.
- Original source or script and the exact submitted version.
- Start, first-output, and accepted-output timestamps.
- First render, correction log, final file, and total charges.


## Score the output against the brief


Check Pass evidence Failure example


Spoken fidelity Required wording and distinctions remain intact. Assigned becomes resolved before a solution exists.


Visual relationship Three stages plus the correct reopening arrow. Reopening leads to a new unrelated ticket.


Labels and readability Correct words, readable at the viewing size. A label is misspelled or overlaps a diagram.


Narration and timing The matching stage is visible as it is explained. The previous stage remains on screen through the next definition.


Correction effort Minutes and operations logged through acceptance. A fast draft needs an unrecorded rebuild.


Export Downloaded file meets the brief and license. Only an in-app preview is available.


Use pass, fail, or not available with a note and timestamp. Do not convert a missing test into a zero, a pass, or an invented quality score.


## An existing Golpo source-to-video example


Golpo's two-minute NIST CSF 2.0 orientation, created from the complete 32-page public source using Canvas Editorial Expanded. This illustrates document-to-explanation, not a cross-tool whiteboard benchmark.


The[documented NIST example](https://video.golpoai.com/guide/ai-visual-explainer-tools-same-pdf-test) explains its source, configuration, required facts, and review boundary. It is separate from the support-script brief above. Neither this video nor its existence proves comparative speed or quality.


## Verify the feature you actually need


Do not assume every scene editor lacks AI, or every AI video product generates whiteboard explanations. Test the exact combination: your source, the intended drawing style, narration, editable scenes, and export. A script-writing assistant, a generated footage clip, and a complete narrated drawing are different outputs.


Golpo supports custom and stock AI Presenters as well as drawn scenes. Business lists API access as a $200 add-on; Scale includes it. Free is one 1-minute watermarked preview; download it without a watermark for $9.99, or subscribe to download it at no extra charge. Confirm these and other plan requirements on[the current pricing page](https://video.golpoai.com/pricing) .


## Choose from evidence you recorded


Compare accepted outputs, correction work, and cost for the same job. Repeat the test with a second source. If one tool cannot support the brief, record the limit and consider whether a different format would serve the audience. This page publishes no multi-tool timing leaderboard or numerical quality ranking.
